entities.summary: Aaron Geramipoor is a British-Iranian professional basketball player for the Johor Southern Tigers of the Major Basketball League Malaysia. He retired from the Iran national team after the Tokyo 2020 Olympics. He was born and raised in Stockport, Greater Manchester.
